question:
(i) Write the formula for the position of the $n^{th}$ bright fringe in Young's double-slit experiment.
(ii) Write the formula for the position of the $n^{th}$ dark fringe.

options.A:
(i) $x_n=\left(n+\dfrac12\right)\dfrac{\lambda D}{d}$ for bright fringes.
(ii) $x_n=\dfrac{n\lambda D}{d}$ for dark fringes.
options.B:
(i) Position of the $n^{th}$ bright fringe: $x_n=\dfrac{n\lambda D}{d}$.
(ii) Position of the $n^{th}$ dark fringe: $x_n=\left(n+\dfrac12\right)\dfrac{\lambda D}{d}$.
options.C:
(i) Bright fringe: $x_n=\dfrac{n d}{\lambda D}$.
(ii) Dark fringe: $x_n=\dfrac{(n+1)d}{\lambda D}$.
options.D:
(i) Bright fringe: $x_n=\dfrac{\lambda D}{nd}$.
(ii) Dark fringe: $x_n=\dfrac{\lambda D}{(n+1/2)d}$.
